name: Timken
outlook:
What Timken says to expect

  • Full year 2026: earnings per share and revenueTimken is increasing its 2026 outlook, with full-year earnings per diluted share now forecasted to be in the range of $4.05 to $4.20 and adjusted earnings per diluted share to the range of $6.35 to $6.50. The company is planning for 2026 revenue to be up approximately 5.5 percent in total from 2025.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
